description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CustomFieldDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test cases verifying CRUD functionalities, search filters, and utility methods related to custom field entities in the HRM system.

classes.name: CustomFieldDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class to verify the functionalities of the CustomFieldDao class, including CRUD operations and search/filter methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including instantiating CustomFieldDao and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a custom field by ID and asserts its properties.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomField
methods.description: Tests deletion of custom fields and verifies the result count.

methods.name: testSearchCustomField
methods.description: Tests searching custom fields with default filter parameters and asserts the count and instance type.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the search with a limit parameter to ensure paginated results.

methods.name: testSaveCustomField
methods.description: Tests creating and saving new custom fields, including auto-incrementing field numbers.

methods.name: testEditCustomField
methods.description: Tests editing an existing custom field and verifying updated properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of custom fields matching search parameters.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithScreen
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by screen attribute.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by specific field numbers.

methods.name: testIsCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Tests whether specific custom fields are marked as in use.

methods.name: testUpdateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Tests updating employee records if a particular dropdown value is in use, verifying the count of affected records.
